about: Correction of the stored turns of the 3 probes of 2026-11-23, made before the batch. The runner records num_turns of the last result event of claude. A background wake-up gives a new result event that counts its own segment only. The corrected value is the count of user entries of the main transcript (transcript_counts.py --copy).

lean-no-advisor.note: 9 result events: the prompt and 8 wake-ups. The last segment has 2 user entries, which is the recorded value.

none.note: No wake-up. The count of the transcript agrees with the record.
